app_fee.value: The official application fee page covers bachelor and master applications through Studielink; no PhD application fee is quoted.

fee_waiver.value: No international fee waiver for PhD applicants appears on the official admission pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the official Graduate School of Science and Engineering or university PhD admission pages.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 4.5 on the new scale (old score 92), with section minimums of 4.0 to 4.5; MyBest scores are not considered.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum score of 4.5 (old score 92) on the internet-based test is required

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 for the science and engineering PhD route; the university-wide page gives 6.5 or 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS overall minimum score is 6.5.

also.quote: A minimum overall score on the IELTS (6.5 or 7.0) is required

english_waiver.value: English-test exemption only if the Bachelor's or Master's was fully taught in English; the exemptions list names no countries, and special cases go to the Board of Admissions.
english_waiver.quote: completed a Bachelor or a Master degree programme which was fully taught in English

notes: Graduate School of Science and Engineering (GSSE) admission rules, used for every GSSE PhD. Application fee: the cited page covers bachelor and master applications and gives no PhD fee. Conflict: the GSSE criteria page says IELTS 6.5, the university-wide English page says 6.5 or 7.0; the 6.5 is kept and the conflict flagged. The GSSE English page URL returned 404, so the university-wide English page was used. Medical Sciences (GSMS) and Engineering PhD rules were not checked; the Engineering PhD page was last modified in 2020 and was not used.
